story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.title: Who did you grow up praying to?
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.sub: The faith you were raised in.
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.hearthkeeper: The Hearthkeeper, at the home fire
Every night your household banked the fire and asked the Hearthkeeper to keep it, and every sickness in the house was nursed beside it.
You learned your prayers to the ring of hammers, and the first thing you were taught to honour was honest work in iron and stone.
Raised to the ring of the Anvil-Father.
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.deep_mother: The Deep Mother, at the shore
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.deep_mother.t: Your people poured the first of every catch back into the sea for the Deep Mother, and you were taught never to turn your back on her.
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.deep_mother.s: Raised on the Deep Mother's shore.
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.green_huntsma: The Green Huntsman, in the woods
Before every hunt your elders thanked the Green Huntsman for what the woods would give, and they left the first cut for him.
Raised under the Green Huntsman's trees.
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.lantern_warde: A lantern burned in your window every night for the Lantern Warden, so the dead would find their road and leave yours alone.
Raised by the Lantern Warden's light.
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.crowned_sun.t: You stood each dawn while the Crowned Sun was hailed, and you learned early that a vow made under it is never broken.
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.ash_whisperer: Your family's prayers were whispered into cold ashes, to the Ash Whisperer, and you learned young to keep them to yourself.
Raised on the Ash Whisperer's quiet.
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.truth.tale: Your household kept no idols, only the Truth: you said what was so, and a lie in that house was the worst thing you could do.
story.jaymoskingdoms.faith.truth.short: Raised to the plain word of the Truth.
